games.2026_05_TB_DAL: Thursday night under a closed roof in Arlington, with storms forecast outside. Tampa Bay starts undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels for the second time with Baker Mayfield's thumb keeping him out at least two more weeks; Antoine Winfield Jr. is out with a rib fracture and Benjamin Morrison and SirVocea Dennis did not practice Monday. Dallas has its own holes: Cobie Durant and DeMarvion Overshown are out again, and Tyler Smith is only designated to return. The rookie quarterback costs the Bucs three points in the model, which has the Cowboys by 4.7; the market by 9.5. The blend lands at 6.8, a High-confidence Dallas pick, but the pure data says the 9.5 is too many and flags Tampa Bay at +370 as a longshot value.
games.2026_05_PHI_JAX: London, with Jacksonville the designated home team. The schedule file calls it a Jaguars home game, but the model treats it as a neutral site and adds the international variance. Philadelphia arrives with the heaviest injury hit on the slate: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith are both doubtful with hamstrings, Dallas Goedert is still out, Zack Baun is in concussion protocol, Quinyon Mitchell and Jonathan Greenard left the Rams game, and Lane Johnson missed last week. The Eagles have also played badly for a month (worst in-season performance in the league after four games), while Jacksonville is 3-1 after winning at Cincinnati. The model has the Jaguars by 13; the market by 6.5. The blend says 10, an 80 percent Jacksonville pick.
games.2026_05_CHI_GB: Two injury-shredded NFC North rivals. Green Bay lost Edgerrin Cooper to a torn Achilles, has Josh Jacobs on the exempt list, and remains without Micah Parsons and Jayden Reed. Chicago starts Tyson Bagent for a third week with Caleb Williams out, is missing Braxton Jones and Jaylon Johnson, and may get Kyler Gordon back from PUP. The Packers' preseason edge has evaporated after a 2-2 start that the data grades as the second-worst four-game stretch in the league, while the Bears have outperformed. Both the model and the market have Chicago by 2.5 to 3 at Lambeau, a Lean.
games.2026_05_CIN_MIA: Heat near 91 degrees and a 15 mph breeze in Miami Gardens. Cincinnati's Ja'Marr Chase is in concussion protocol and Tee Higgins has an adductor strain, both day-to-day; Joe Burrow threw for 428 yards in the loss to Jacksonville. Miami is 0-4 with Malik Willis at quarterback, has lost De'Von Achane for the season and Reese Taylor for this week, and rates as the worst team in the league. Even with both receivers at 45 percent to miss, the model has the Bengals by eight; the market by seven. High confidence on Cincinnati.
games.2026_05_CLE_NYJ: Cleveland has won three straight with Deshaun Watson, but rookie Mason Graham is out with knee and ankle sprains, Elgton Jenkins and Teven Jenkins are questionable, and the Browns are on ten days' rest after Thursday. The Jets are 1-3 and ran a franchise-low 32 plays in Chicago; Breece Hall, Mason Taylor, Dylan Parham and Jarvis Brownlee Jr. are all questionable. The ratings are nearly even (both bottom-ten teams), the model has Cleveland by less than a point on the road and the market has the Jets by 1.5. The blend leaves the Jets a 51 percent coin flip; the pure data flips it to Cleveland.
games.2026_05_HOU_TEN: A battle of 0-4 teams in Nashville. Houston has blown late leads in consecutive weeks and is missing Braden Smith, Henry To'oTo'o, E.J. Speed and Jayden Higgins long-term with Azeez Al-Shaair and Jadeveon Clowney questionable, but C.J. Stroud and the preseason rating keep the Texans a touchdown better than Tennessee, whose Cam Ward line and two new guards on IR drag them to the bottom of the ratings. Model: Texans by 5.5; market by 7. Moderate confidence, with the Titans at +270 just inside the value threshold.
games.2026_05_IND_PIT: Indianapolis beat Washington in London and gets the extra-rest edge over a Pittsburgh team that played Thursday. The Colts are without Alec Pierce and Arden Key, with Keenan Allen questionable; the Steelers lost Derrick Harmon to IR and Jamel Dean for a couple of weeks after the Browns loss. The model has the Colts by a point on the road, the market has the Steelers by 2.5, and the blend splits the difference at Pittsburgh by less than half a point. A coin flip that the pure data flips to Indianapolis.
games.2026_05_LV_NE: New England beat Buffalo and comes home 2-2 but battered: A.J. Brown is on IR, Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore have missed two weeks with shoulders, Mack Hollins left the Bills game, and Harold Landry has not practiced. That is a 5.4-point hit against a Raiders side that rates below average but has played better than its number (first loss came by three to Kansas City). Drake Maye is still worth 1.5 points over what Las Vegas fields. Model and market both say Patriots by about three; Moderate confidence.
games.2026_05_MIN_NO: The biggest disagreement with the market this week. Minnesota is 4-0 (its offense has not scored a touchdown in two games, but the defense has carried it), while New Orleans gave up 45 to Atlanta and has lost Travis Etienne to IR with Kelvin Banks already out; Chris Olave and Kaden Elliss are questionable. Justin Jefferson's ankle keeps him questionable. The model has the Vikings by nine in the Superdome; the market by only 1.5. The blend settles at 5.7 and Minnesota -125 is the best value on the board.
games.2026_05_NYG_WAS: Jayden Daniels returns from the dislocated elbow in a brace, with Marcus Mariota now out and a rookie as the only backup, so Washington carries a small rust trim and extra variance. Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is questionable and Tunsil, Newton and Armstrong remain out; Sam Cosmi and Nick Cross are expected back at practice. New York beat Arizona behind Jameis Winston but is without Brian Burns and Paulson Adebo. The ratings are even and both teams rate well below average; the model has the Giants by a point on the road, the market has Washington by three, and the blend keeps the Commanders a 53 percent coin flip. The pure data flips it to New York.
games.2026_05_DEN_LAC: Both teams lost their cornerbacks: Denver has Patrick Surtain II doubtful and Riley Moss questionable, while the 0-4 Chargers hit the six-point injury cap with Rashawn Slater out for weeks, Joe Alt (neck), Derwin James and Ladd McConkey all questionable, and Biadasz, Perryman and Njoku on IR. Los Angeles has underperformed badly for four weeks and Herbert posted a season-low 189 yards in Seattle. Model: Broncos by five under the SoFi roof; market by 3.5. Moderate confidence on Denver.
games.2026_05_DET_ARI: Detroit comes off a Sunday night loss in Carolina with Rock Ya-Sin doubtful and Tyleik Williams in a boot, and still without Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph. Arizona is 1-3 under Mike LaFleur, lost James Conner and Will Johnson for the long term, and Jacoby Brissett threw three interceptions at the Giants. Closed roof in Glendale (101 degrees outside). The ratings have slipped for both, and the model has the Lions by only two against a market 4.5; the blend says three, a Lean on Detroit, with Arizona +180 flagged as value.
games.2026_05_SF_SEA: The best game of the week and the two top-rated teams in the model. Seattle is at home in the rain with a healthier roster (Anthony Bradford to IR is the main loss); San Francisco is 4-0 but will be without Nick Bosa, Kyle Juszczyk and Marques Sigle, with Upton Stout questionable and Mykel Williams possibly activated from PUP. Darnold, not Drew Lock as the schedule file says, starts for the Seahawks. The 49ers have been the better team on the field so far, but the four-point injury differential and Lumen Field swing it: model Seahawks by six, market by three, blend 4.5. Moderate confidence, Seattle -164 is a small value.
games.2026_05_BAL_ATL: Sunday night in Atlanta hinges on Lamar Jackson's left ankle. He left the Tennessee game at halftime in a walking boot and had an MRI Monday; Baltimore calls it day-to-day, so the model prices a coin flip between Jackson and Tyler Huntley, which costs the Ravens 1.6 points and adds variance. Marlon Humphrey is doubtful, both centers are on IR, and Hendrickson, Stanley and Vorhees are questionable. Atlanta just scored 45 at New Orleans but carries its own 5.8-point hit (A.J. Terrell on IR, Drake London and Kyle Pitts questionable, Pearce suspended). Model and market both say Ravens by 2.5 to 3; a Lean on Baltimore. If Jackson is ruled out, this flips to Atlanta.
games.2026_05_BUF_LA: Monday night between two of the five best teams in the ratings. Buffalo lost for the first time and limps in with Christian Benford, DJ Moore, Ed Oliver and Dee Alford all questionable. The Rams rallied to win in Philadelphia, expect Aaron Donald and Jaylen Watson back, and are still without Myles Garrett and Terrance Ferguson. Josh Allen and Matthew Stafford roughly cancel. Model: Rams by 3.8 at SoFi; market by 2.5. Blend 3.2, a Moderate pick on Los Angeles.
